QUOTE: `library/common.h:132`, `#define MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` | Unconditional for every library `.c` that includes `common.h` (about 129 files). Inside the library, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to the real `x`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the shared header common.h unconditionally defines the opt-out for library code, so library files see the real (plain) member names.
